svg.text: PostgreSQL 16 · migrations src/tank/migrations/001–007 + ops.schema_migrations (storage.py) · 9 schemas · 54 tables · 16 FK · 154 indexes · ER diagram generated from the DDL by scripts/render_db_schema.py · IE (crow’s foot) notation
FOREIGN KEY: child 0..N → parent 0..1 (the FK column is nullable)
composite FK: the second column joins with a dotted line
Line colour = schema of the child table. Every FK targets a unique
domain id (UNIQUE INDEX), not the storage_key PK.
composite UNIQUE: columns sharing a number
CHECK required_…: NOT NULL or a reason in document
hides the paired <col>_prec text and <col>_prec_reason text columns (timestamp precision)
Document envelope (grey): storage_key text PK · document jsonb NN · immutable bool NN DEFAULT false
(DEFAULT true in ops.capture_tier_transitions); mkt.* has no envelope: storage_key is only UNIQUE, no PK
trigger ops.protect_immutable: UPDATE/DELETE of a row with immutable=true fails
the table has no PRIMARY KEY
indexes incl. PK/UNIQUE (btree, GIN on document, partial)
market capture control (series live in ClickHouse)
Not enforced by the schema (computed from migrations 001–007)
Design §14 bigserial PRIMARY KEYs that are not even UNIQUE: evt.state_changes.id, out.deliveries.id, ops.llm_usage.id
50 by-convention references (→ …) have no FK although the target is unique: reg.tokens ×19, evt.events ×12, reg.instruments ×6, reg.entities ×4, reg.sources ×3, others ×6
2 more would work as composite FKs: ana.calls(opened_by_alert, opened_by_version) → out.alerts; evt.beneficiary_edges(event_id, map_version) → evt.beneficiary_maps
4 cannot be FKs as the schema stands (target not unique, or an array): evt.state_changes.edge_id, out.alerts.decisions, out.deliveries.question_id, ops.telegram_files.question_id
17 tables are unique only on storage_key; writers put the domain id there (e.g. edge_id, question_id)
8 tables have no PRIMARY KEY: 7 × mkt.* (storage_key UNIQUE NOT NULL), ops.request_budget_ledger (no key at all)
FK columns are nullable; required_* CHECKs are NOT VALID (enforced on new writes, existing rows unchecked)
all: DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED · ON DELETE/UPDATE NO ACTION
by-convention references (→ …) carry no FK constraint
